description: This file is a Python script implementing a linter adapter for CMake files, specifically using 'cmakelint'. It defines classes, functions, and logic to run the linter, parse its output, and handle errors.

classes.name: LintSeverity
classes.description: An enumeration of severity levels for lint messages.

classes.name: LintMessage
classes.description: A data structure representing a lint message with details such as file, line, message, severity, etc.

methods.name: run_command
methods.description: Executes a command with arguments and returns the completed process, logging execution time.

methods.name: check_file
methods.description: Runs 'cmakelint' on a specified file with a given config, parses the output into lint messages.
